text:
zoe (People Ops): Idea: run a recurring 'Sprint Spotlight' recognition tied to each engineering sprint wrap (small $15 e-gift + virtual badge). Fast, low-friction nominations during sprint retro. Who can help run ops? :zap:
ian (Engineering): I can coordinate with eng leads to call out a sprint nominee each retro. Keep nomination to 1 line: who + why.
maria (Events): I can design the virtual badge (Slack emoji + profile sticker) and handle any small physical token requests. Lead time 3 days for pins.
harpreet (Finance): Quick budget note: $15 x est 40 recipients/sprint = $600 per sprint. Need recurring GL or charge code; payroll wants recipient legal name + email for records.
rewards-bot: Reminder: prior ad-hoc spot program needed 2 business days to process e-gifts. Consider bulk vendor.
zoe (People Ops): Preference: bulk e-gift CSV upload to vendor so finance gets one invoice. Maria, can badge + emoji be ready in 48 hours?
maria (Events): Yes for digital assets. For any physical items, we’ll cap to local offices. International folks get e-gifts only.
harpreet (Finance): Agreed on e-gifts for global. Also will set up a 'Sprint-Spotlight' GL 540-SS for recurring use. Need to see the CSV template.
ian (Engineering): Process suggestion: during retro lead posts nomination in a thread with repo link + 1-line reason; People Ops compiles at end-of-day Friday and sends CSV Monday morning.
rewards-bot: Scheduling note: automation can post a reminder 24h before retro if you want.
zoe (People Ops): Action items:
- ian: pilot with two teams next sprint and post nominations thread (assigned)
- maria: create badge + emoji by Thu (assigned)
- harpreet: confirm GL + share CSV template by Fri (assigned)
- zoe: set up vendor contact and message copy (assigned)
Please react with :white_check_mark: if you can.
ian (Engineering): :white_check_mark:
maria (Events): :white_check_mark:
harpreet (Finance): :white_check_mark:
zoe (People Ops): Thanks! We'll keep this lightweight — 1 nominee per sprint per team. Iterate as needed.
rewards-bot: Reminder scheduled to #people-ops on 1789015000 to check pilot nominations.
zoe (People Ops): Closing loop: I'll post a 2-line announcement to eng slack today so leads know it's coming.
